title: 预算与实际费用差异
context: 财务负责人检查部门年度超支。
requirements: 2025年部门×费用科目，预算与费用分录各自汇总，偏差=实际-预算；超过预算10%标记；保留有预算但没有发生额的项目；分母为零返回NULL。
commonError: 预算按月存在，连接分录后再求和会放大预算。
mysqlSql: WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id ORDER BY b.department_id,b.account_id
